This is an excellent opportunity for a cyber security professional looking to build a long-term consulting career while gaining exposure to governance, assurance, compliance, risk management, and security uplift initiatives. Working alongside experienced cyber practitioners, you'll help organisations strengthen their security posture through practical governance and risk outcomes while developing valuable consulting and stakeholder engagement skills.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will:
  • Develop and maintain security policies, standards, procedures, and governance documentation.
  • Conduct security risk assessments and maintain risk registers and treatment plans.
  • Produce high-quality, client-ready security deliverables aligned with regulatory and business requirements.
  • Support governance, risk, compliance, and assurance activities across multiple client environments.
  • Assist with security assessments, gap analyses, and remediation planning.
  • Contribute to security uplift initiatives and continuous improvement activities.
  • Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders to gather requirements and provide security advice.
  • Prepare professional reports, presentations, and compliance documentation.
  • Support audit, accreditation, and security assurance activities where required.
About You
To be successful in this role, you will have:
  • 2-5 years' experience in Cyber Security, GRC, Security Governance, Compliance, Risk Management, or related disciplines.
  • Experience developing security artefacts including policies, procedures, standards, risk assessments, and governance documentation.
  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce professional, client-ready deliverables.
  • Experience engaging with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Understanding of cyber security governance, risk management, and compliance principles.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Passion for cyber security and a desire to build a long-term consulting career.
  • Australian Citizenship with the ability to obtain and maintain a Government Security Clearance.
Highly Desirable
  • Experience within Federal Government, Defence, or other regulated environments.
  • Knowledge of ISM, PSPF, Essential Eight, ISO 27001, and NIST.
  • Exposure to security assessments, audit activities, compliance reviews, or assurance engagements.
  • Experience maintaining risk registers and developing risk treatment plans.
  • Security Officer or DISP-aligned experience.
  • Exposure to ITSA, accreditation, or Authority to Operate (ATO) activities.
  • Technical understanding of infrastructure, cloud, networking, or cyber security environments.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Azure, and cloud security concepts.
  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, ISO 27001 Foundation, CISMP, or similar.
What's on Offer?
  • Opportunity to launch or accelerate your career in cyber security GRC.
  • Exposure to Federal Government, Defence, and critical infrastructure environments.
  • Work alongside experienced cyber security and consulting professionals.
  • Gain hands-on experience delivering real-world governance and risk outcomes.
  • Exposure to frameworks including ISM, PSPF, Essential Eight, ISO 27001, and NIST.
  • Diverse project work across security governance, assurance, compliance, and risk management.
  • Strong career growth opportunities within a growing cyber security consultancy.
